axisKb.axis-what-a: AXIS is the built-in assistant for Kouma. It answers questions about the platform, summarises conversations, creates tasks, and searches documents.
axisKb.axis-can-a:
- Answer **questions about Kouma** (Chat tab)
- **Summarise** a conversation (Summary tab)
- Create a **task** (Action tab)
- **Search** a document or meeting minutes (Search tab)
axisKb.axis-limit-a: AXIS only answers questions about Kouma. It does not write free-form text.
axisKb.general-what-a: Kouma Workspace is an end-to-end encrypted collaboration platform: messaging, documents, calendar, teams, and announcements in one secure space.
axisKb.general-support-a: Contact support at **support@kouma.io** with a description of the problem and a screenshot if possible.
axisKb.general-pwa-a: Kouma is a PWA. On mobile, open Kouma in Chrome or Safari then use **"Add to Home Screen"**. No app store required.
axisKb.general-browser-a: Kouma works on Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari. Prefer **Chrome** or **Edge** for best performance.
axisKb.general-version-a: Kouma updates automatically. Reload the page to get the latest version.
axisKb.general-price-a: Pricing is available at **kouma.io/pricing**. Contact support for enterprise offers.
axisKb.onboard-join-a: You need to receive an **invitation** from your administrator. Click the link received by email, create your password and PIN code.
axisKb.onboard-create-org-a: Go to **kouma.io/create**, enter your organisation name and create your admin account.
axisKb.onboard-invitation-error-q: My invitation link does not work
axisKb.onboard-invitation-error-a: Ask your **administrator** to generate a new link: Admin console → Users → Invite.
axisKb.onboard-pin-setup-q: How to create my PIN code?
axisKb.onboard-pin-setup-a: The PIN code is created during your first sign-in. It protects your encryption key. Remember it well — without it, access to your encrypted messages may be compromised.
axisKb.msg-send-a: Type your message in the input field and press **Enter**. For a line break: **Shift+Enter**.
axisKb.msg-direct-q: How to start a direct conversation?
axisKb.msg-direct-a: In Messages, click **+** at the top and select a collaborator.
axisKb.msg-group-q: How to create a group chat?
axisKb.msg-group-a: In Messages, click **+** and select several collaborators to create a group.
axisKb.msg-react-q: How to react to a message?
axisKb.msg-react-a: Hover over the message and click the **smiley** icon. Choose your emoji from the panel.
axisKb.msg-reply-q: How to reply to a specific message?
axisKb.msg-reply-a: Hover over the message and click the **reply** icon. Your message will be linked to the original with a quote.
axisKb.msg-file-a: Click the **paperclip** icon to attach a file. Formats: images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ZIP. Max size: **50 MB**.
axisKb.msg-delete-a: Hover over your message and click the **trash** icon. Only the sender can delete their own messages.
axisKb.msg-edit-a: Hover over your message and click the **pencil** icon. Edited messages display a Edited label.
axisKb.msg-leave-a: In a conversation, click the **three dots** at the top right → **Leave conversation**.
axisKb.msg-unread-q: How to see my unread messages?
axisKb.msg-unread-a: Conversations with unread messages show a **red badge**. Click on the conversation to mark them as read.
axisKb.msg-encrypt-a: All messages are **end-to-end encrypted** (AES-256-GCM). Neither Kouma nor administrators can read them.
axisKb.msg-find-q: How to find an old message?
axisKb.msg-find-a: Use the **Search** tab in AXIS and type keywords.
axisKb.msg-team-channel-q: Where to find my team conversation?
axisKb.msg-team-channel-a: Each team has a **dedicated conversation** visible in your Messages, with all its members automatically included.
axisKb.msg-not-sending-a:
1. Check your internet connection
2. Reload the page and enter your PIN
3. If the problem persists, contact support
axisKb.msg-decrypt-error-a: Reload the page and enter your PIN code to restore your encryption session.
axisKb.msg-forward-a: Hover over the message and click the **forward** icon. Select the destination conversation from the list.
axisKb.msg-copy-a: Hover over the message and click the **copy** icon. The text is copied to your clipboard.
axisKb.msg-photo-view-q: How to view a photo in full size?
axisKb.msg-photo-view-a: Photos display directly in the conversation. Click on them to view in full screen.
axisKb.msg-scroll-reply-q: How to scroll back to the original message?
axisKb.msg-scroll-reply-a: Click the quote block in a message to jump directly to the original message.
axisKb.teams-view-a: Find all your teams in the **Teams** section of the navigation.
axisKb.teams-create-a: Reserved for **administrators**: Admin console → Teams → New team.
axisKb.teams-add-member-q: How to add a member to a team?
axisKb.teams-add-member-a: Adding members is reserved for **administrators**. Contact your admin to be added to a team.
axisKb.teams-remove-member-q: How to remove a member from a team?
axisKb.teams-manage-a: Admin console → **Teams**. You can edit the name, members and delete a team.
axisKb.docs-upload-a: In **Documents**, click **+ New** and select your file. It is encrypted automatically.
axisKb.docs-preview-a: Click on a file in Documents. Images and PDFs open directly in the app. For other formats, a download button is available.
axisKb.docs-folders-nav-a: Click on a folder to navigate into it and view its files. Use the breadcrumb to go back.
axisKb.docs-create-folder-a:
Click **+ Folder**, give it a name and choose its visibility:
- **Personal**: visible only to you
- **Organisation**: visible to all members
axisKb.docs-folder-visibility-a:
**Personal**: visible only to you.
**Organisation**: visible to all organisation members.
axisKb.docs-move-doc-q: How to move a file into a folder?
axisKb.docs-move-doc-a: Drag a file and drop it onto a folder to store it there. You can also drag and drop from the list view.
axisKb.docs-delete-folder-a: Hover over the folder and click the delete icon (visible to the creator and admins). Files are automatically moved to the root.
axisKb.docs-visibility-a:
- **Personal**: visible only to you
- **Team**: visible to your team members
- **Organisation**: visible to all members
axisKb.docs-download-a: Open the document and click **Download**. The file is decrypted automatically.
axisKb.docs-formats-a: Accepted formats: **PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Images (PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP), Text (txt/csv), ZIP**. Max size: **50 MB**.
axisKb.docs-size-q: What is the maximum file size?
axisKb.docs-size-a: The maximum size per file is **50 MB**. Compress into ZIP for larger files.
axisKb.docs-delete-a: In **Documents**, click the **three dots** next to the file → **Delete**.
axisKb.docs-find-a: Use the search bar at the top of Documents or the **Search** tab in AXIS.
axisKb.docs-encrypt-a: Documents are end-to-end encrypted. Administrators cannot read personal documents.
axisKb.agenda-create-a: In **Calendar**, click **+ New meeting**. Fill in the title, dates, participants and description.
axisKb.agenda-view-a: Find all your meetings in the **Calendar**. Meetings you are invited to appear there automatically.
axisKb.agenda-rsvp-q: How to accept or decline a meeting?
axisKb.agenda-rsvp-a: In **Calendar**, open the meeting and click **Accept** or **Decline**.
axisKb.agenda-invite-a: When creating the meeting, select participants in the **Participants** field. They receive a notification and see the meeting in their Calendar.
axisKb.agenda-cancel-a: Open the meeting in **Calendar** and click **Delete**. Only the organiser can delete.
axisKb.agenda-minutes-a: In **Calendar**, open the meeting and click **Minutes**. Fill in the summary, decisions and actions.
axisKb.agenda-action-item-q: How to add an action item in minutes?
axisKb.agenda-action-item-a: In meeting minutes, click **+ Add action**. Assign it to a member with a due date. Check it once completed.
axisKb.agenda-not-invited-q: I cannot see a meeting in my calendar
axisKb.agenda-not-invited-a: If a meeting doesn't appear, you are not invited. Ask the organiser to add you.
axisKb.agenda-organizer-a: The organiser is displayed in the meeting details. They are the only one who can edit or delete it.
axisKb.ann-view-a: Announcements are in the **Announcements** section of the navigation. They are published by administrators.
axisKb.ann-create-a: Reserved for **administrators**: Admin console → Announcements → + New announcement.
axisKb.ann-notify-q: Am I notified of new announcements?
axisKb.ann-notify-a: When an announcement is published, all members receive a **notification**.
axisKb.profile-edit-a: In **Me**, click **Edit profile** to change your first name, last name, job title and photo.
axisKb.profile-avatar-q: How to change my profile photo?
axisKb.profile-avatar-a: In **Me**, click on your avatar and upload a new photo.
axisKb.profile-password-a: In **Me** → Security → **Change password**. Your current password is required.
axisKb.profile-pin-q: How to change my PIN code?
axisKb.profile-pin-a: In **Me** → Security → **Change PIN code**. A PIN change re-encrypts your data automatically.
axisKb.profile-jobtitle-q: How to edit my job title?
axisKb.profile-language-q: How to change the interface language?
axisKb.profile-language-a: In **Me** → Preferences → **Language**. Kouma is available in French, English, Spanish and Portuguese.
axisKb.profile-signout-a: In **Me**, click **Sign out** at the bottom of the page.
axisKb.profile-theme-a: In **Me** → Preferences → **Appearance**. Toggle between light and dark mode.
axisKb.profile-notif-prefs-q: How to manage my notification preferences?
axisKb.profile-notif-prefs-a: In **Me** → Preferences → **Notifications**. Choose which types of alerts to receive (messages, meetings, announcements…).
axisKb.admin-invite-a: Admin console → Users → **Invite**. A unique invitation link is generated.
axisKb.admin-users-a: Admin console → **Users**. View all members, invite, suspend or promote to admin.
axisKb.admin-departments-a: Admin console → **Departments**. Create departments and assign members to them.
axisKb.admin-teams-manage-a: Admin console → **Teams**. Create, edit and delete teams.
axisKb.admin-logo-q: How to change the organisation logo?
axisKb.admin-logo-a: Admin console → Settings → **Organisation**. Upload your logo and edit the name.
axisKb.admin-permissions-a: Admin console → **Permissions**. Set rights by role (Admin, Collaborator).
axisKb.admin-storage-a: Admin console → **Storage**. View used space and the largest files.
axisKb.admin-audit-q: How to access the audit log?
axisKb.admin-audit-a: Admin console → **Log**. Records all important actions: sign-ins, uploads, invitations, etc.
axisKb.admin-promote-q: How to promote a user to admin?
axisKb.admin-promote-a: Admin console → Users → click the member → **Promote to administrator**.
axisKb.admin-security-a: Admin console → **Security**. Configure session duration, OTP and password policy.
axisKb.admin-disable-user-a: Admin console → Users → click the member → **Suspend**. Access is revoked immediately.
axisKb.admin-announcements-q: How to publish an official communication?
axisKb.sec-e2e-a: Kouma uses **end-to-end encryption** (ECDH P-256 + AES-256-GCM). Data is encrypted on your device. Neither Kouma nor servers have access to the keys.
axisKb.sec-admin-cant-read-a: Administrators **can never read** your private or group messages. Decryption keys are stored only on your devices.
axisKb.sec-pin-why-q: What is the PIN code for?
axisKb.sec-pin-why-a: The PIN code decrypts your private key. Without it, even if your account is compromised, your messages remain unreadable.
axisKb.sec-pin-forgot-a: Contact your **administrator** to initiate a recovery via the organisational recovery key. Without this key, encrypted data cannot be recovered.
axisKb.sec-recovery-a: Recovery goes through the **organisational recovery key** (breakglass phrase), held by the admin. Without it, encrypted data is unrecoverable.
axisKb.sec-session-q: How long does my session last?
axisKb.sec-session-a: Session duration is configured by your admin (Admin console → Security). At expiry, enter your PIN again.
axisKb.sec-team-recovery-q: Can an admin access team messages?
axisKb.sec-team-recovery-a: **Team** conversations have a recovery key that the admin can use if legally required. **Direct and group** conversations are inaccessible even to admins.
axisKb.sec-data-where-a: Kouma data is hosted on secure servers. Only authorised members can decrypt the data. See our privacy policy for details.
axisKb.poll-create-a: In **Messages**, open a conversation and click the **poll** icon. Enter the question and options, then publish.
axisKb.poll-vote-q: How to vote in a poll?
axisKb.poll-vote-a: Find the poll in the conversation and click your choice. One vote per poll.
axisKb.poll-results-a: Results are visible in real time by all members of the conversation.
axisKb.poll-notify-q: Am I notified of new votes?
axisKb.poll-notify-a: The poll creator receives a notification for each new vote.
axisKb.minutes-create-a: In **Calendar**, open a meeting and click **Minutes**.
axisKb.minutes-view-a: Open the meeting in **Calendar** and click **Minutes**.
axisKb.minutes-action-q: How to manage action items in minutes?
axisKb.minutes-action-a: In meeting minutes, click **+ Add action**. Assign it to a member with a due date.
axisKb.minutes-who-can-see-a: Meeting minutes are visible to all **invited participants** of the meeting.
axisKb.notif-push-a: Kouma sends **browser notifications** (push) even when the tab is in the background. Allow them when the browser requests.
axisKb.notif-inapp-a: In-app notifications appear in the **bell** at the top of the navigation. They are only visible when you are logged in to Kouma.
axisKb.notif-push-vs-inapp-q: What is the difference between push and in-app?
axisKb.notif-push-vs-inapp-a:
**Push**: browser/OS alert, visible even if Kouma is closed.
**In-app**: badge in the interface, visible only when Kouma is open.
Both are complementary.
axisKb.notif-no-receive-a:
1. Check that notifications are **allowed** in your browser settings
2. Check that Kouma is open in a tab
3. Reload the page
axisKb.notif-types-q: What do I get notified about?
axisKb.notif-types-a: Kouma notifies you for: **new message**, **meeting invitation**, **RSVP reply**, **new vote** on your polls, **new announcement**.
axisKb.err-cant-login-a:
1. Check your **email and password**
2. Check your internet connection
3. Try **Forgot password**
4. Contact your admin if the problem persists
axisKb.err-pin-wrong-a: Check that you are entering the correct code. After several failures, contact your **administrator** for a recovery.
axisKb.err-upload-fail-a:
1. Check the file is **less than 50 MB**
2. Check the **format is accepted**
3. Check your connection
4. Reload and try again
axisKb.err-blank-screen-q: The page is blank / the app is not loading
axisKb.err-blank-screen-a:
1. **Ctrl+Shift+R** (or Cmd+Shift+R on Mac) to force reload
2. Clear browser cache
3. Try in private browsing
4. Contact support if it persists
axisKb.err-session-lost-q: My session is lost after reload
axisKb.err-session-lost-a: Reloading the page asks for your PIN again. Enter it to restore your session. The encryption key is stored only in memory for security.
axisKb.err-notif-denied-a:
**Chrome**: padlock in URL → Notifications → Allow
**Firefox**: Menu → Preferences → Privacy → Notifications
**Safari**: Preferences → Websites → Notifications
axisKb.err-file-type-a: Allowed formats: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Images (PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP), Text (txt/csv), ZIP. Executables (.exe, .app…) are blocked.
axisKb.err-quota-a: Your storage quota is reached. Delete files or contact your admin to increase the quota (Admin console → Storage).
